rest.$description: Rest state for a brand-tinted glow shadow (e.g. LinkButton's outline style) — a deliberate exception to elevation.json's neutral-black rule for the rare case a shadow needs to read as an accent glow, not a depth cue. Geometry matches elevation.lg; color comes from --vvp-primary-muted at low opacity instead of black.

hover.$description: Hover/emphasis state for the same glow: identical geometry, stronger tint — intensity carries the emphasis instead of growing the shadow past elevation.lg's size.
